recognitionRules: Retain the notebook margin and top rule as a stable writing frame.
Pair Optima instructions with Noteworthy annotations only where a handwritten cue adds meaning.
Place a worked example before the guided attempt, with response lines close to each prompt.
Use muted green and earth tones without tinting every writing area.

writingLinks.name: Patient coach
writingLinks.reason: Moves a beginner through supported steps to independent practice without condescension.

quote: Try a first version. Compare it with the example. Change one thing.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use FIELD NOTES in Optima with PRACTICE below and a short margin rule to the left. No illustrated notebook icon is needed.
invariants: Retain the notebook margin and top rule as a stable writing frame.
Pair Optima instructions with Noteworthy annotations only where a handwritten cue adds meaning.
Place a worked example before the guided attempt, with response lines close to each prompt.
adaptations: A single activity sheet retains the example, attempt and reflection sequence.
Increase writing space rather than compressing prompts for print.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
